observed_failure.interpretation: Actual non-acquired attempt events existed, but no acquired rows events were recorded. This is a monitor gap, not proof of correct or incorrect production lock order; native rerun with the fixed monitor remains mandatory.

confirmed_source_cause.native_fixture: mysql.NewConfig retains InterpolateParams=false; actual installer connector is its clone. No driver interpolation configuration was changed.
confirmed_source_cause.driver: mysqlConn.query returns driver.ErrSkip for parameterized query when InterpolateParams=false. QueryContext forwards that error after finishing its context watcher. database/sql then uses native PrepareContext and mysqlStmt.QueryContext.
confirmed_source_cause.gap: Old monitor wrapped only successful Conn.QueryContext rows. It returned ErrSkip normally; database/sql's prepared fallback statement and rows were unwrapped. Its native Rows.Next therefore never reached nativeMinioLockRows.Next, so acquired remained empty despite actual queries/locks.

correction.instrumentation: Add independent nativeMinioLockStmt wrapping the actual native statement from Conn.Prepare/PrepareContext. Stmt.QueryContext/Query forward unchanged SQL arguments/context and wrap only matching exact lock-query returned native rows with the existing nativeMinioLockRows.
correction.execution_route: Conn.QueryContext still returns driver.ErrSkip unchanged. database/sql retains its actual default fallback and statement-close lifetime. No monitor-owned SQL execution fallback, transaction, fabricated rows or lock results.
correction.transparency: Pass through native Stmt.ExecContext and ColumnConverter to preserve context cancellation, execution and original argument conversion. Embedded Stmt retains Close/Exec/NumInput. Missing mandatory pinned-driver context capabilities fail instead of substituting results.
correction.acquired: Unchanged nativeMinioLockRows.Next first calls actual driver.Rows.Next. Only a successful real first row emits the acquired event. No acquired event is produced by Prepare, QueryContext return, attempt dispatch, time delay or static expected sequence.
correction.preserved_assertions: All original shared-blocker, exact real connection IDs, performance_schema exact owned schema/table wait-edge requirement, no-commit-through-lock, original seven-row acquired order and signed post-revoke readback assertions remain unchanged in minio_sql_native_test.go.
correction.scope: Only the explicitly superseded native monitor test source changed. Production SQL/lifecycle/current reader, migration135, existing A fault/native fixture source, other frozen SQL sources, Region owner files, historical manifests and remote state were not changed by this patch.
